pieces.Text: You are a conduit for the might of the dark powers. Your DR increases to 10/good. Whenever you use Smite Good and successfully strike a good outsider, the outsider is also subject to a Banishment at caster level

(you weapon and unholy symbol automatically count as objects that the subject hates). After the Banishment effect and the damage from the attack is resolved, the smite immediately ends. In addition, whenever you channel negative energy or use touch of corruption to damage a creature, you deal the maximum possible amount.
